verdicts.line: [D27] Ghosts paint on layers the view's `layerVisibility` / `layerOrder` hide (scour) — fixed 587d0807f9
[D16] Departure ghosts of a removed scrolling container's children leave out its scroll offset (scour) — fixed 9caaeee9fe
[D20] Departure ghosts are drawn once, not once per copy a container draws (scour) — fixed bf043c0570
[D4] Departure ghosts fold an envelope parent's own pose into its children's place (scour) — fixed f218b1912e
[D5] A preset's own tool named in `defaultTools` skips the "inserts nothing" check (scour) — fixed 8b169de4a1
[D24] `resolveToolRegistry` repeats its patch warnings on every render (scour) — fixed 51c78ebfcf
[D23] `defaultActiveTool` under a `ToolsApi` takeover throws instead of being ignored (scour) — fixed f45449afca
[D15] Muting the marker-drag action leaves markers claiming presses (scour) — fixed cf39e4edf1
[D21] the actions prop's warn-once warnings repeat on every render with an inline literal (scour): fixed 59cc90086d

[D25] actions={null} mutes the presets' own actions, and only those registered before it (scour): fixed 59cc90086d. `null` now mutes exactly the canvas's standard action ids plus the viewport ids, whenever they register. Any other action stays live, whatever order it registered in.
[D10] a full actions[slot] entry whose id differs from its slot registers under entry.id, so the resolver goes stale on every change (scour): fixed 59cc90086d

[D17] SceneCanvas passes no style to the dispatcher-overlay layer, so DispatcherOverlayStyle can't reach the paint (scour): fixed af7f533a9d. This adds a public `dispatcherOverlay` layer slot that takes `{ style }`, a pre-built `{ layer }`, or `null`. Before, the canvas's own layer also overwrote a consumer's `dispatcherOverlay` entry.

[D28] a custom selectionOverlay entry loses its before/after anchors, unlike pathEditingOverlay (scour): not a defect. `selectionOverlay` is a standard slot that `composeOrderedLayers` (`canvas/layerOrder.ts`) always places in canonical order, as it does `grid` and `cellHighlight`. `pathEditingOverlay` is a custom key, which is why its anchors apply.
[D3] the finiteness guard sums pick-box fields, so a finite box near 1e308 gets null bounds (scour): fixed cadf45d524

[D14] a press routed to a view id the registry doesn't hold loses lod-aware and pixel picking (scour): fixed b1b9b4f0ac. With no view registry mounted at all, a view id still counts as another view's, as the existing pixels test expects.
[D13] the defaultActiveTool doc says any `tools` prop ignores it, but only the takeover form does (scour): fixed 4a635dfddf
- [D1] dropped or rounded-away animation frame on a controlled camera leaves the write flag set (scour): fixed 3c3c5ddc05
- [D6] on a scene swap, the selection seed uses the `initial` captured at mount (scour): fixed 25672f4d78
- [D12] the cached content box isn't invalidated when the adapter changes (scour): fixed a349352b20
- [D18] an overlay style field passed as undefined erases its default (scour): fixed cb19d26d2c
- [D2] the edge-pan limit clamps with ancestor-scaled client dimensions (scour): fixed 74db938c33
- [D26] the preview ghost paints a node under a hidden container still in the scene (scour): fixed a3b5b39b4d
- [D8] the handle `addView` returns keeps drawing its id after a re-add (scour): fixed e997216a1e
- [D7] `extendClickLocked: undefined` in `selectTool` erases the path-edit lock (scour): fixed 75547cb793

[D11] `routing={[]}` turns off double-click naming of a member's outermost group (scour): fixed 89d093a11b. The fix also covers a `routing` list that classifies nothing as `'group'`: a structural group is now always named.

[D19] pinch zoom from `viewport.touchZoom` buried under the kit default when the standard actions re-register under the same ids (scour): fixed 38f51b30bd. `rev` is now the set's identity key (`actionSetKeyOf`), the same key `useActionSet` re-registers on.

[D22] `outline.follow 'shape'` with `poseById` puts handles on the stroke when `boundsIncludeStroke` is false (scour): fixed 7f83fd08c9. The selection overlay takes a new `shapes` option, so tracing no longer shares `scene` with bounds. That adds API, so the commit has a second, `minor` changeset for core and editing.
[D9] warning that navigation "does nothing" when `viewport` only switches it off (scour): fixed 11478f362f
